memories.content: Harborview Credit Union has a policy to provisionally credit disputed charges within ten business days of the dispute filing. They received Marisol's dispute today (2026-10-14). They process disputes through their internal system.

Marisol filed a dispute with Harborview Credit Union on 2026-10-14 for a 320-dollar charge on her card. The credit union quoted a ten-business-day window for provisional credit. The ten business days from 2026-10-14 end on 2026-10-28 (excluding weekends and the federal holiday on 2026-10-12? Actually, 2026-10-14 is a Wednesday; ten business days later is 2026-10-28, a Wednesday). The hard cutoff is 2026-10-28T17:00:00-08:00.
